title: Finite coefficient change on henselian polynomial cylinders
statement: Let $\Lambda\hookrightarrow V$ be a finite injective local map [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], where $\Lambda,V$ are both fields or both complete discrete valuation rings [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring]. Let $e\geq0$, put $D=\Lambda[[u_1,\ldots,u_e]]$, $E=V[[u_1,\ldots,u_e]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], and let $S=(D[T]_{(\mathfrak m_D,T)})^h$ and $S_V=(E[T]_{(\mathfrak m_E,T)})^h$ be ordinary henselizations [def-weil-polynomial-ring, def-weil-pbc-henselization-at-prime]. Then $D,E$ are complete Noetherian local domains, $S,S_V$ are excellent Noetherian henselian local domains [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology, def-exc-excellent-ring], and $S\to S_V$ is finite and local. Put $R=D[[T]]$ and $R_V=E[[T]]$. The canonical maps identify the maximal-ideal completions of $S,S_V$ with $R,R_V$, respectively, and the natural map $R\otimes_S S_V\to R_V$, $a\otimes b\mapsto ab$, is an isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Moreover $R_V$ is finite over $R$. If $g=T^n+\sum_{i<n}b_iT^i\in D[T]$ with $n>0$ and $b_i\in\mathfrak m_D$, then $(S,gS)$ and $(S_V,gS_V)$ are henselian pairs, and $R,R_V$ are also their respective $g$-adic completions [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Both completion maps are faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].
